summary: Verified mobile responsive fix for BookingWizard horizontal overflow. Tested 4 pages at 390x844 (home, /book, /student-discount, /man-and-van/kilburn) — all report scrollWidth==innerWidth==390 (0px overflow). Mobile stepper shows single 'Step 1 of 6: Addresses' label via data-testid='wizard-step-label'. Continue button rendered within viewport (x=233, width=116, right=349 < 390). Desktop 1280x800 regression: all 6 step labels (Addresses, Floors, Date & time, Van, Photos & items, Contact) visible and no overflow.
critical_code_review_comments: Console shows repeated 401 errors on page load — likely an auth/me probe on public pages. Non-blocking for this task but worth suppressing for cleaner UX/logs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: BookingWizard responsive fix verified across all 4 pages that embed it. Overflow measured via document.documentElement.scrollWidth vs window.innerWidth. Mobile label testid: wizard-step-label. Desktop labels are direct text nodes.
rca of the issue: Not applicable — verification only; fix by main agent (flex-1 min-w-0 on stepper items, hidden labels on mobile, w-full min-w-0 on wizard root) resolved horizontal overflow.
